title: Fibre-sum (area formula) identities for F = (|x|, angle) on the carrier, with the Jacobian computed
statement: Let P ∈ ℕ, R = (M, θ, ξ) ∈ IMRep(ℝ^P, 2) with μ := R.measure, Q a 2-dimensional linear subspace of ℝ^P, a, e ∈ Q with |a| = |e| = 1 and ⟨a, e⟩ = 0, and s ∈ ℝ. Assume p_{T_x}(x) = x for μ-a.e. x, where T_x := approxTangentPlane 2 M x and p_{T_x} its orthogonal projection. Put π := Q.starProjection, f(x) := arctan(⟨x, e⟩/⟨x, a⟩), F̃(x) := (|x|, f(x)) ∈ ℝ × ℝ, Z_s := {x : ⟨x, a⟩ > 0, ||x| − 1| < s, |f(x)| < s, |x − πx| < s|x|}, Ax := ⟨x, a⟩e − ⟨x, e⟩a, w(x) := |p_{T_x}(Ax)|, G(x) := w(x)²/|πx|², J(x) := w(x)/|πx|², and for p ∈ ℝ × ℝ the fibre sums H(p) := Σ_{x ∈ M ∩ Z_s ∩ F̃⁻¹{p}} θ(x)·w(x) and N(p) := Σ_{x ∈ M ∩ Z_s ∩ F̃⁻¹{p}} θ(x) in [0, ∞] (tsums over the subtype). Then H and N are a.e.-measurable for Lebesgue measure on ℝ × ℝ, and for every measurable b : ℝ × ℝ → [0, ∞], ∫ b(p)H(p) dp = ∫_{Z_s} b(F̃(x))·G(x) dμ(x) and ∫ b(p)N(p) dp = ∫_{Z_s} b(F̃(x))·J(x) dμ(x) (lower Lebesgue integrals in [0, ∞]).
